Method of Attack: Chaining CVE-2023-28432 (information disclosure) and CVE-2023-28434 (code replacement) vulnerabilities to replace legitimate MinIO software with a modified version containing a remotely accessible backdoor
Social engineering to convince DevOps engineer to downgrade MinIO to vulnerable version
Remote access to environment variables including MINIO_SECRET_KEY and MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD
Modification of software update URL to push malicious update
Execution of remote commands via backdoor URLs
Post-compromise downloading of additional payloads for system profiling, network reconnaissance, account creation, PING scanning, and deployment of China Chopper-like webshell
Impacted Systems: MinIO object storage systems (all versions before RELEASE.2023-03-20T20-16-18Z)
Attack Vector: Exploitation of MinIO vulnerabilities CVE-2023-28432 and CVE-2023-28434
Remote code execution via backdoor in modified MinIO software
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of modified MinIO application named Evil MinIO
Use of environment variables MINIO_SECRET_KEY and MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD accessed remotely

Post-compromise payloads including system profiling scripts, network reconnaissance scripts, Windows account creation scripts (accounts named 'support' or 'servicemanager'), PING scan scripts using asyncio Python module, and China Chopper-like webshell
